status_note: Combined SDD-01 and WBC-02 candidate on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (unchanged), rebuilt from merged main (SDD-01, #104) by WBC-02 as the second lander. SDD-01 adds the native HTML designer (sophia-html-designer-v1) and the separate visual reviewer (sophia-visual-review-v1), their identity-only presets, their routes (the research route, which declares image input) and the bundle's verified skills/ files (prompt sections, native skills, references, Raven notice). WBC-02 adds the source reviewer (role and preset sophia-source-review-v1, its three review tools and instruction v1 in the bridge) and its route source-review-luna-high-v1 (the approved development model, openai/gpt-6-luna at high, under the provider alias openai-review with a 16,000-token output cap and metered against each review's allowance). The default route, the M02 roles, the research roles, their route and compaction are unchanged. Not live-verified and not deployed; the cutover is in place, a Codex operation after review, under the no-live-work guard on sophia-runtime-m03-dev (WBC-02-CX-0022). Rollback unit: sophia-runtime-m03-dev, rebuilt from its own commit.

presets.definition: identity only: each preset composes no plugin (plugins: []). The bridge mounts the role's preset on create and resume, applies the role's tool policy, and records the preset with a digest of its definition and that policy in the attempt's execution identity (SMC-M02 G3). The gate requires exactly this roster, unbroadened. The SMC-M03 research presets compose their research tools from S4; the SDD-01 design presets get their design or review tools and their prompt sections and skills from the bridge, in the agent's own scope; the WBC-02 source-review preset gets its three review tools and its instruction from the bridge, in the agent's own scope.

research-sol-medium-v1.live_checklist: Codex, under a recorded allowance: tools with strict:false accepted; cached_tokens > 0 on turn 2 or later; cache_write_tokens reported; a 400 on prompt_cache_retention as a negative control; the real context limit

source-review-luna-high-v1.decided: WBC-02 (2026-10-05, implementation proposal for Davide's approval in the operation request): the source reviewer runs on the currently approved development route, OpenAI GPT-6 Luna at high reasoning (model_route above), through a provider alias of its own so the bridge can bound every call's output at 16,000 tokens and meter it against the work's allowance. Not a new vendor, model or effort; the payer is the route's credential below until the owner names another
source-review-luna-high-v1.model_entry_source: declared in the Sophia bundle patch with the values of the pi-ai 0.87.1 catalog entry openai/gpt-6-luna that this pin ships (window 272,000, the compat of model_route), its output capped at 16,000. source-review-luna-high-v1.live_checklist: Codex, under the pilot's recorded allowance: one review completes within eight model calls; every call reserved and settled; the bridge refuses a ninth; usage reported per run; the effective provider, model and effort on the attempt's identity
